name: Smirking Spelljacker
oracle_text:
Flash
Flying
When this creature enters, exile target spell an opponent controls.
Whenever this creature attacks, if a card is exiled with it, you may cast the exiled card without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, exile target spell an opponent controls

needs.what: an op that moves a targeted spell (a kind: "spell" target, by ctx.target_sids) from the stack to exile -- not a counter, so it works on a spell that can't be countered and emits no SPELL_COUNTERED -- and records the 607.2a link (link_exiled) from the exiled card to the source, so a later {"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"} selector finds it. With that, the attack trigger is an `attacks` trigger with an `exists` condition on that selector and a `may` around `play_exiled`, all of which already exist
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `exile` resolves `objects: {"target": "t1"}` through resolve_pool, which keeps only object refs, so on a spell target it is a silent no-op (the same trap op_return_spell_to_hand documents); `objects: {"zone": "stack"}` is untargeted and sweeps every spell. `counter` with `exiles: true` and `as` is countering, not exiling: it fails against an uncounterable spell and fires counter triggers, and it never calls link_exiled, while its `as` binding dies with the resolution, so the later attack trigger's "exiled with it" cannot read the card
